mechanics.claim: Gwen's basic attacks generate a stack of Snippy on-hit for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times and refreshing on subsequent attacks.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Snippy'' {{tip|on-hit}} for 6 seconds, stacking up to 4 times and refreshing on subsequent attacks.

mechanics.claim: Gwen snips at least twice in a cone over the cast time, with the final snip dealing increased damage; if she has any Snippy stacks she consumes them to snip an additional time for each.
mechanics.quote: '''Gwen''' snips at least twice with her scissors in a {{tt|cone|see notes}} in the target direction over the cast time, dealing {{as|magic damage}} per snip to all enemies within the area, with the final snip dealing increased damage.

mechanics.claim: The center of each snip converts 50% of that snip's damage to true damage, then applies A Thousand Cuts.
mechanics.quote: The center of each snip converts 50% of the damage to {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}|true}}, then applies ''{{ai|A Thousand Cuts|Gwen}}''.

mechanics.claim: Snip Snip! deals only 80% damage against minions and executes them on the first damage instance if they are below 20% health.
mechanics.quote: ''Snip Snip!'' deals 80% damage against {{tip|minions}}, and executes them on the first damage instance if they are {{as|'''below''' 20% health}}.

mechanics.claim: A spell shield blocks only one snip of the multi-hit ability, not the whole cast.
